id: title:aspicer:move scheduled jobs off minute zero

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the execution time of scheduled background jobs for error tracking recommendations and symbol set cleanup, potentially affecting when these maintenance tasks run and could impact downstream availability or recommendation freshness.
review.reason: Adds deterministic offsets and jitter to scheduling intervals for background maintenance tasks. This is a localized, bounded change to execution timing rather than a substantive capability or systemic risk reduction. No broader systemic implementation or critical path dependency is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact depends on the underlying scheduling implementation and dependency chain, which are not fully demonstrated in this hunk. No adoption, incident avoidance, or specific benefit is inferred.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are available and complete; no abstention. No adoption, incident avoidance or effort is inferred. No score assigned; tier requires broader assessment.
